exclusions.subject: workspace-and-session-activity
exclusions.reason: Open source-native event vocabulary; not a bounded product family.

exclusions.subject: work-organization-and-resources
exclusions.reason: Open provenance or semantic relationship strings; validation is contextual rather than one closed family.

exclusions.subject: source-registry-and-scans
exclusions.pattern: version, fingerprint, error-code, tool-operation, capability JSON fields
exclusions.reason: Internal versioned protocol identifiers, not user-visible bounded database state.

exclusions.subject: maintenance-execution
exclusions.reason: Extensible protocol fields are validated by versioned manifests and are not one database presentation axis.

exclusions.subject: derived-retrieval-index
exclusions.reason: Extensible internal provenance string; ordinary screens derive labels from the owning entity instead.

exclusions.subject: local-context-corpus
exclusions.reason: Open MIME vocabulary rather than a closed product state.

exclusions.subject: review-and-resume-continuity
exclusions.reason: User or model-authored content and open relation semantics are not enums.

exclusions.subject: usage-and-cost-records
exclusions.pattern: models, calculator versions, total_semantics, numeric coverage states
exclusions.reason: Versioned identifiers, source semantics, or numeric facts rather than closed presentation families.

exclusions.subject: source-registry-and-scans
exclusions.pattern: identifiers, paths, names, timestamps, hashes, error text, JSON payloads
exclusions.reason: Free-form identity, evidence, or content fields are not bounded value families.

exclusions.subject: workspace-and-session-activity
exclusions.reason: Pin state is represented by row presence and a timestamp, not by a bounded status value.

exclusions.subject: workspace-and-session-activity
exclusions.pattern: numeric, range, shape, length, null-correlation, and composite CHECK constraints
exclusions.reason: Structural invariants are documented by table owners but do not define selectable value vocabularies.
